stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Show them the front of the studio.

stations.title: pictures folder
stations.text: Her drawings of the studio and a mug.

captions: Dilys wants people to recognise Kilnworth Pottery when they walk down Saddler Street.
Her drawings sit in the pictures folder, but the page shows only words.
You add the pictures, describe them, give them a size and caption the mug.
The studio front is at the top of the page, described for everyone.
Same page, now with pictures that everyone can see or hear.
